name: @one-source/docs-mcp
description: MCP server for OneSource Web3 API documentation — search docs, explore GraphQL schema, find examples

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const d=p.join(__dirname,'data');if(!fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'schema-data.json'))||!fs.existsSync(p.join(d,'skills'))){console.error('ERROR: data/schema-data.json and data/skills/ must exist before publishing. Run npm run build:plugin from the repo root.');process.exit(1)}"
